pub fn classify_block(input: &[u8; BLOCK_BYTES], carry: &mut ScanCarry) -> Result<BlockMasks>
test_vectors: Explicit JSON vector with exact raw punctuation, string content, whitespace, digit, structural, and valid masks.
Empty input with all four canonical quote carry combinations and opaque UTF-8 state preservation.
All 256 byte values in all 64 lanes against exact expected raw classes, including ASCII whitespace/control overlap and unsigned non-ASCII classification.
Individual quotes and backslashes at every bit position, including bits zero and 63.
Every length from zero through 64 against an independent byte oracle, with zero and space blocks checking padding exclusion.
Fixed-array and slice equivalence for all 256 repeated byte values and all four canonical quote carry combinations.
Backslash runs of lengths zero through 63 followed by a quote, with every split point and all canonical incoming quote states.
Full-block trailing backslash followed by an escaped quote, punctuation inside a string, a closing delimiter, and punctuation outside the string.
Invalid JSON syntax, invalid escapes, unclosed strings, control bytes, invalid UTF-8, and non-ASCII whitespace remain classifiable.
Oversized lengths 65, 255, 256, 257, and 1024 return scanner InvalidToken at offset zero without mutating carry, including when carry is also invalid.
Noncanonical quote carry values 2, 3, 255, 256, the high u64 bit, and u64::MAX return scanner InternalError without mutation for both public entry points.
